verdict.rationale: Pylon tracks issues across Slack Connect, email, Microsoft Teams, the chat widget, in-app mobile SDKs and forms. Its Support Agent is assigned to issues, so it can plausibly act across those channels. There is no evidence of WhatsApp or social-media channels, and the docs never explicitly confirm that one agent answers customers on every channel. Missing for 10: WhatsApp support, social channel support, explicit evidence that the Support Agent responds natively per channel, independent corroboration.
